{{Top|leg}}
'''HoloNet News Service''' was a news agency that clamored for data on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] activities, during the height of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It eventually merged with [[HoloNet News and Entertainment]].
